# add-option

Add an option to a column's local option set

## Usage

```
ppds attribute add-option [options]
```

## Options

| Long | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--column` | `-c` | `string` |  | Logical name of the Choice/Choices column |
| `--correlation-id` |  | `string` |  | Correlation ID for distributed tracing |
| `--debug` |  | `bool` |  | Show trace-level diagnostic output |
| `--dry-run` |  | `bool` |  | Validate only, do not persist changes |
| `--entity` | `-e` | `string` |  | Logical name of the entity |
| `--environment` | `-env` | `string` |  | Override the environment URL. Takes precedence over profile's bound environment. |
| `--option` |  | `string` |  | Option to add: "Label[:Value][:#Color]" |
| `--output-format` | `-f` | `OutputFormat` |  | Output format |
| `--profile` | `-p` | `string` |  | Authentication profile name |
| `--publish` |  | `bool` |  | Publish the entity after the change |
| `--quiet` | `-q` | `bool` |  | Show only warnings and errors |
| `--solution` | `-s` | `string` |  | Solution unique name (required for value derivation when --option has no explicit value) |
| `--verbose` | `-v` | `bool` |  | Show detailed output including debug messages |
